paragraphs.text: A traditional tower windmill turns the energy of the wind into a force that grinds grain. At the top of the tower sits a wooden cap, which can be turned so that the sails always face into the wind.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The four sails are attached to a horizontal shaft called the windshaft. As the sails turn, a large wheel on the windshaft drives a smaller gear connected to a vertical shaft running down through the tower.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: At the bottom of this shaft, the power is passed to a pair of heavy millstones. Grain is poured into a wooden hopper above the stones and falls slowly between them, where it is crushed into flour.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The flour then travels down a chute into sacks on the ground floor. A miller could control how fine the flour was by adjusting the gap between the stones.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Many old windmills have now been restored, and some still produce small amounts of flour that are sold to visitors.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: At the top of the tower sits a wooden cap

explanation.en: At the top is “a wooden cap” that turns into the wind → cap. Leave out “wooden”: one word only.
explanation.kk: Мұнараның басында — «a wooden cap», оны желге қарай бұрады → cap. «Wooden» керек емес: бір сөз.
explanation.ru: Наверху башни — «a wooden cap», который поворачивают по ветру → cap. «Wooden» не нужно: одно слово.

items.quote: The four sails are attached to a horizontal shaft called the windshaft

explanation.en: “a horizontal shaft called the windshaft” → windshaft, one word. The “vertical shaft” is a different part below.
explanation.kk: «a horizontal shaft called the windshaft» → windshaft, бір сөз. Сызбадағы «vertical shaft» — төмендегі басқа бөлшек.
explanation.ru: «a horizontal shaft called the windshaft» → windshaft, одним словом. «Vertical shaft» на схеме — другая деталь ниже.

items.quote: Grain is poured into a wooden hopper above the stones

explanation.en: “Grain is poured into a wooden hopper above the stones” → hopper. Part 3 sits above the stones in the diagram.
explanation.kk: «Grain is poured into a wooden hopper above the stones» → hopper. Сызбада 3-бөлік диірментастың үстінде тұр.
explanation.ru: «Grain is poured into a wooden hopper above the stones» → hopper. На схеме часть 3 стоит над жерновами.

explanation.en: “a pair of heavy millstones” → millstones (“stones” from the same paragraph is accepted). After “pair of” use the plural.
explanation.kk: «a pair of heavy millstones» → millstones (сол абзацтағы stones да есептеледі). «Pair of» тіркесінен кейін — көпше түр.
explanation.ru: «a pair of heavy millstones» → millstones (засчитывается и stones из того же абзаца). После «pair of» — множественное число.

items.quote: The flour then travels down a chute into sacks on the ground floor
items.prompt: 5 ____ (flour is collected on the ground floor)

explanation.en: Flour goes down a chute “into sacks on the ground floor” → sacks. “Chute” is already labelled above part 5.
explanation.kk: Ұн науамен «into sacks on the ground floor» түседі → sacks. «Chute» сызбада 5-бөліктің үстінде жазылған.
explanation.ru: Мука идёт по жёлобу «into sacks on the ground floor» → sacks. «Chute» уже подписан на схеме над частью 5.
